database_scope.version: derivative of mc_fe v2.062, source commit 19b11640253543fe412145498438cb8355a32561
database_scope.note: v1.1 only changes the database identity the approval is bound to: the selected database is now the third-party community clean derivative. The approved (sample, element, category) triples are unchanged from v1.0, which remains on record as history.

rationale: pycalphad 0.11.2 with mc_fe v2.062 cannot describe every element present in the two heats. Rather than silently dropping elements or filling missing values with zero, the Workbench records a versioned, per-sample, per-element exclusion decision. Elements outside this enumerated list keep the strict behaviour: a non-zero element that the database does not cover blocks the run with CALPHAD-COMP-002, and an element declared without a value blocks with CALPHAD-COMP-001.

allowed_categories.database_not_covered: the element is non-zero in the sample composition but the registered database contains no ELEMENT entry for it
allowed_categories.measured_zero: the element was measured and its registered value is exactly 0 wt.% while the database does not cover it
allowed_categories.input_unknown: the element is declared in the composition table but has no measured value; it is NOT treated as zero

approved_exclusions.reason: mc_fe v2.062 contains no ELEMENT entry for As, Sn or Sb, so the database cannot model them. Values were measured and are non-zero; they stay recorded in the run record and are excluded from the thermodynamic component system only.
The registered values for this heat are exactly 0 wt.%, so the elements contribute nothing to the component system.
The composition table declares these columns but holds no measured value. They are not treated as zero; they are excluded from the model system until a measurement exists.

not_approved: Any element not listed above, for any sample.
Any non-zero element that the registered database does not cover, unless it is one of the triples above.
Any wildcard, pattern or 'ALL' form of exclusion.
Any exclusion that would apply across databases: the decision is scoped to MATCALC-MC-FE-V2062.

limitation_notice.zh: 本结果是基于 pycalphad 0.11.2 与 mc_fe v2.062 的缩减成分体系平衡热力学预测。R-DQ 中 As、Sn、Sb 未被数据库建模；O、W 因缺少测量值未进入计算。结果不能用于判断这些元素对偏聚、夹杂、晶界脆化、相稳定性或性能的影响。
limitation_notice.en: This result is an equilibrium thermodynamic prediction for a REDUCED component system, computed with pycalphad 0.11.2 and mc_fe v2.062. As, Sn and Sb are not modelled by the database for R-DQ, and O and W are not part of the calculation because no measured values exist. The result must not be used to judge the effect of these elements on segregation, inclusions, grain-boundary embrittlement, phase stability or properties.

privacy_note: This committed policy deliberately contains no measured composition values. The per-run record, which does contain the measured values, is written to the git-ignored outputs/ directory.
